subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: After a redacted failed request/response capture is available, should OpenClaw solve this proxy fallback gap with another targeted sanitizer, clearer diagnostics/docs, or a new explicit strict-minimal completions compatibility mode?
rationale: The current evidence proves partial hardening and a plausible failure path, but not the exact incompatible field; adding strict-minimal or per-provider feature-disabling surface would be a product/config contract choice.

options.title: Capture first, then patch narrowly
options.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main proxy capture identifies the failing field, then prefer a targeted sanitizer or diagnostic over new config surface.

options.title: Design strict-minimal mode
options.body: Accept a new explicit compatibility mode or provider/model knob for narrow proxies, with docs and upgrade-safe defaults.

options.title: Documentation-only boundary
options.body: Document the full request contract for `openai-completions` and treat narrower proxies as unsupported unless they opt into existing `extra_body`/compat settings.

recommendation.title: Capture first, then patch narrowly
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a current-main proxy capture identifies the failing field, then prefer a targeted sanitizer or diagnostic over new config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the live assignee on the issue and can decide whether to request more reporter proof or sponsor a product/config direction.
